name: Ackerman Farms
description: Ackerman Farms is an agritourism farm in 158 U.S. Hwy. 150 (Jackson St.), IL, open to visitors for seasonal picking and farm activities. Offerings follow the growing season, so what is available changes through the year. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
